mapper.select:
select s.name_kana as supplier, prd.supplier_id , s.name as supplier_name , count(prd.pr_detail_id) as detail_count , jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'prId', pr.pr_id ,'displayNumber', pr.display_number ) order by pr.display_number asc ) as purchase_requests , sum(prd.subtotal_excluding_tax) as total_amount_excluding_tax from purchase_request pr join purchase_request_detail prd on pr.pr_id = prd.pr_id join supplier s on prd.supplier_id = s.supplier_id where prd.snap_kind = #{itemKind}
and s.supplier_id = #{form.supplierId}
and pr.status = 'APPROVED' group by prd.supplier_id , s.name , s.name_kana
union all
select prd.snap_supplier_name as supplier, string_agg(prd.supplier_id, '') as supplier_id , prd.snap_supplier_name as supplier_name , count(prd.pr_detail_id) as detail_count , jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'prId', pr.pr_id ,'displayNumber', pr.display_number ) order by pr.display_number asc ) as purchase_requests , sum(prd.subtotal_excluding_tax) as total_amount_excluding_tax from purchase_request pr join purchase_request_detail prd on pr.pr_id = prd.pr_id where prd.supplier_id is null and prd.snap_kind = #{itemKind} and pr.status = 'APPROVED' group by prd.snap_supplier_name
order by
supplier
detail_count
total_amount_excluding_tax
, supplier asc

select 'DETAIL_SELECTION' as view_key, sum(prd.subtotal_excluding_tax) over() as total_amount_excluding_tax,
pr.pr_id, pr.display_number, sum(prd.subtotal_excluding_tax) over(partition by pr.pr_id) as pr_total_amount_excluding_tax,
prd.pr_detail_id, row_number() over(order by pr.display_number asc, prd.line_no asc) - 1 as index, prd.snap_item_name as item_name, prd.snap_unit_price as unit_price, prd.subtotal_excluding_tax,
prd.snap_unit_name as unit_name, prd.quantity
from purchase_request pr
join purchase_request_detail prd on pr.pr_id = prd.pr_id
prd.supplier_id = #{supplierId}
prd.snap_supplier_name = #{supplierName} and prd.supplier_id is null
and prd.snap_kind = #{itemKind} and pr.status = 'APPROVED'
order by pr.display_number asc, prd.line_no asc
